title: Visualizing a Loaded Image From the Train Dataset

cues.en: Welcome back.

cues.zh: 不一定需要翻轉，我只是放在這裡，說明影像經過 transforms 流程時會發生什麼。

cues.en: And then most importantly, we've turned our images into a torch tensor.
